testsuite.name: timeshealth.server.CmsApiTest

testcase.name: live class states follow the clock and the stream is only given on join()
deleting content that is still used is refused clearly()
schedule a week of classes for a batch, safely re-runnable()
admin API is never offered to other origins()
playback hands the dashboard video or a signed URL, members only for paid sessions()
members-only classes need the membership, and a member join counts attendance()
validation reports every field problem at once()
hand-picked rail shows exactly the chosen videos in order()
the live classes rail appears on Home once classes are scheduled()
writes need the dashboard header()
create, edit and delete a testimonial, with an audit trail()
viewers are read-only()
routes not ported yet are 404 when no Node upstream is configured()
a past run's route is given to its owner only()
too early and cancelled classes can't be joined()
home follows the admin's sections, order and visibility()
wrong password is refused and a forged cookie is ignored()
dashboard API needs a session()
a past run with its route goes to its owner only()
a scheduled section shows only inside its window, and audiences are respected()
a session's dashboard video is offered only to those who may play it()
